name: Claude Code Persistence
description: Persists Claude Code state across container rebuilds and across DevContainers. Identity and config (credentials, .claude.json, settings, skills, commands, agents, CLAUDE.md, plugins, ...) are shared with the host's ~/.claude; all per-session and runtime state (conversation history, auto-memory, caches) is kept in the project's .devcontainer/ so it is scoped per repository.
